fine_lines.title: verb + -er = the person
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نضيف er إلى الفعل لنحصل على الشخص الذي يقوم بالفعل: pitch → pitcher، catch → catcher، field → fielder. إذا انتهى الفعل القصير بحرف ساكن بعد حرف علة واحد نضاعف الحرف الأخير: bat → batter، run → runner.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Add -er to a verb to name the person who does it: pitch → pitcher, catch → catcher, field → fielder. In short verbs ending in one vowel + one consonant, double the last letter: bat → batter, run → runner.

examples.sentence: The runner runs to first base.

fine_lines.title: run (verb) vs run (noun)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: run كفعل = يركض. run كاسم في البيسبول = نقطة يسجلها الفريق عندما يعبر اللاعب home plate.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Run as a verb = move fast on your feet. A run as a noun in baseball = one point, scored when a runner crosses home plate.

fine_lines.title: each vs every
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما يأتي مع اسم مفرد. each يركّز على كل واحد على حدة، و every يركّز على المجموعة كلها. Each team has many players.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both go with a singular noun. Each looks at the members one by one; every looks at the whole group.

examples.sentence: Each time a batter bats, the runners run.
Every child in the class likes baseball.

grammar.title: Simple present: he / she / it + -s
grammar.explanation_ar: في المضارع البسيط نضيف s أو es إلى الفعل مع المفرد الغائب (he / she / it أو اسم مفرد): The pitcher pitches. ومع الجمع (they أو اسم جمع) لا نضيف s: Pitchers pitch. الأفعال المنتهية بـ ch / sh / s / x تأخذ es: pitch → pitches، catch → catches.
grammar.explanation_en: In the simple present, add -s or -es to the verb with he / she / it or a singular noun: The pitcher pitches. With plural subjects (they, plural nouns) there is no -s: Pitchers pitch. Verbs ending in ch / sh / s / x add -es: pitch → pitches, catch → catches.
examples: Pitchers pitch the ball. / The pitcher pitches the ball.
Catchers catch the ball. / The catcher catches the ball.
Batters bat the ball. / The batter bats the ball.
Runners run the bases. / The runner runs to first base.

grammar.title: Describing steps: First, Then, Each time
grammar.explanation_ar: لشرح طريقة أو قواعد لعبة نستخدم المضارع البسيط مع كلمات الترتيب: First (أولاً)، Then (ثم)، Each time (في كل مرة).
grammar.explanation_en: To explain how something works or the rules of a game, use the simple present with order words: First, Then, Each time.
examples: First, the pitcher pitches the ball to the batter.
The batter bats the ball. Then, the runner runs to first base.
Each time a runner runs across home plate, they score a run!

grammar.title: Superlative: the most
grammar.explanation_ar: the most + اسم = الأكثر عدداً: The team with the most runs wins = الفريق صاحب أكبر عدد من النقاط يفوز.
grammar.explanation_en: the most + noun = the biggest number of something.
examples: The team with the most runs at the end of nine innings wins the game!
